dedupe_keys.name: hertfordshire farm typologies and catchment water impact assessments

description: This Mendeley Data collection supports a catchment-scale life-cycle impact assessment of arable and livestock farming in Hertfordshire, eastern England. Researchers combined farm survey inputs, soils and rainfall with five example farm workbooks and a scenario impact-assessment workbook. They compared acidification and eutrophication under farm-management interventions, using several impact-assessment methods. The current public version 3 is CC BY 4.0. The Data in Brief article cites a draft link to version 4, but the named repository API exposed version 3 during this review. The five examples are not the full anonymised regional farmer survey. A publicly listed file is labelled as containing farmer personal information and consent; its contents were not accessed and must be checked before any reuse. Typology aggregation and assumed intervention effects limit inference about individual farms or measured river quality. A reviewer-assessed use is testing water-quality outcomes of agricultural management scenarios. platform-openlca is related by life-cycle modelling function; direct compatibility was not verified.
